title: Request then wrapped Reject-PDU response
purpose: Cover the reject branch with a paired sequence so the response-style MMS Reject-PDU appears after a small confirmed request rather than as an isolated raw tag.
expected_behavior: The target should first parse the confirmed request and then enter the MMS reject branch on the wrapped response carrying tag 0xa4.
constraints_preserved: Request uses documented MMS Confirmed-Request-PDU tag 0xa0 and service [2].
Response uses documented ACSE type 0x61 and MMS tag 0xa4 for Reject-PDU.
Both messages preserve definite BER lengths.
Simple invoke-style integer bytes are kept consistent and mutation-friendly.
issue_safety_notes: This is not an error-trigger replay; it is a conservative paired branch-coverage sequence.
